title: Convenient Downtown 2Bed & 2Bath!
description:
This spacious 1,134 sqft, 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom condo is located right downtown and is completely walkable!  This place is great for 2 couples, a group of friends, or a family that wants to enjoy Nashville in style! The unit is updated with granite countertops, full modern kitchen, wood floors, and exposed brick walls. No need to rent a car or call an Uber here!

Guest access
Guests will have access to the entire condo, minus a storage closet.
